name: Diabetes screening (NHANES adults)
source: NHANES 2017–2018 (CDC): adults with HbA1c and an answer to “ever told you have diabetes?”. Positive = told by a doctor, or HbA1c ≥ 6.5%
citation: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, National Center for Health Statistics. National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey 2017-2018.

cohort.step: Answered the diabetes question (yes / no / borderline)

split: StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=0): one row per patient
